Start with small packs: Try the Variety Pack on Chewy or Amazon, or single packs at PetSmart, so your pup can taste-test without a big commitment.
Look into discounts: If you’re a First Responder or Military Veteran, you can apply for a discount on Nom Nom orders by reaching out to our Pet Support Team.
Get a tailored quote: Because pricing depends on things like your dog’s number, age, weight, activity level, recipes, and your ZIP code, our Pet Support team can put together a personalized cost estimate for you.
